conjecture: For a closed symmetric monoidal C with small coproducts, the container extension <<->> : Fam(C^op) -> C-enriched-[C,C], <<S,P>> = coprod_s [P_s,-], acts on homs by prod_s of the canonical comparison gamma_{(X_t)} : coprod^Set_t C(I,X_t) -> C(I, coprod^C_t X_t) with X_t=[Q_t,P_s]. FLAGSHIP T1: <<->> is FULLY FAITHFUL iff the monoidal unit I is CONNECTED, i.e. C(I,-):C->Set preserves small coproducts. This is NOT extensivity of C: Set x Set is (l)extensive yet <<->> is not full (unit (1,1) disconnected); Vec fails because C(k,-)=forgetful does not preserve (+). The controlling invariant is unit-connectedness, correcting Neil's 'extensive <=> full' conjecture. Faithful iff coproduct injections are I-disjoint (so <<->> is NOT faithful over Vec: zeros collapse), full iff gamma surjective. Set is the classical AAG case because 1 is connected (its hidden hypothesis).
note: Neil #1 (email UID 120) flagship T1. Generalizes the Vec instance (linear-containers-vec) to arbitrary closed base. Method: enriched co-Yoneda (Nat(h_P,G)=G(P)) + Nat out of coproduct = product of Nats, reducing full/faithful to whether C(I,-) preserves coproducts. HONEST CORRECTIONS to PROVE.md brief: (i) the iff is with UNIT-CONNECTEDNESS not extensivity -- Set x Set counterexample (extensive, not full); (ii) 'faithful always' is FALSE -- <<->> not faithful over Vec (zero-collapse). Computationally witnessed (F_3 Vec: 6 morphisms, image 5 of 9; Set x Set: 2 morphisms vs 4 nat transfs). Prior art cited not reproved: AAG (Set full-faithful, re-derived + hypothesis named), Dorta-Jarvis-Niu 2305.05655 (tensor/composition defs over general base; disjoint from full-faithful question), Diers (reconstruction S=pi_0(el F) uses extensivity of the CODOMAIN Set -- a different theorem, whose fusion with (a) at C=Set is why folklore said 'extensivity'). T2 (closedness) and T3 (change of base = change of enrichment): T3 proved as corollary; T2 conjectured (gaps).

tree.approach: T1 fullness criterion over a closed base: full-faithful iff unit connected; extensivity refuted as the invariant (Set x Set counterexample)

children.approach: Thm 1.3 + Rem 1.3a: Nat_set(<<S,P>>,<<T,Q>>) = prod_s C(I, coprod^C_t [Q_t,P_s]), via enriched co-Yoneda (Lemma 1.1) and Nat(coprod_s F_s,G)=prod_s Nat(F_s,G) (Lemma 1.2). Set-level, no completeness needed.

Def 1.4: <<->> acts on the s-component as gamma_{([Q_t,P_s])} : coprod^Set_t C(I,[Q_t,P_s]) -> C(I,coprod^C_t[Q_t,P_s]), the canonical 'does C(I,-) preserve this coproduct' map (using C(Q,Z)=C(I,[Q,Z])).
Thm 2.1(1): C(I,-) preserves small coproducts => every gamma is a bijection => <<->> fully faithful. Clean, general.

Thm 2.1(2): <<->> full (resp faithful) => C(I,-) preserves (resp reflects) all copowers T.Z, via source ({s},Z) target (T,(I)). Disconnected unit (some copower unpreserved) => not full. Part (3) upgrades to full connectedness when a cogenerator [-,Z0] is essentially surjective (Vec_fd finite coproducts); caveat noted for infinite Vec where the copower test suffices anyway.
Cor 3.1: C=Set, I=1, Set(1,-)=Id preserves coproducts => full-faithful. Re-derives Abbott-Altenkirch-Ghani AND names its hidden hypothesis (1 connected).
Cor 3.2: C=Vec, I=k, C(k,-)=forgetful does not preserve (+) => neither full nor faithful; the ∐⊊⊕ crux. Cites the fully-worked Vec instance.

Cor 3.3 + Thm 3.4 (THE DELIVERABLE): C=Set x Set is (l)extensive but unit (1,1) is DISCONNECTED (C((1,1),(X,Y)+(X',Y'))=(X+X')x(Y+Y') != XxY + X'xY'), so <<->> is NOT full. Explicit witness: source ({s},(1,1)), target ({t1,t2},((1,1),(1,1))) has 2 container morphisms but 4 natural transformations. => Extensivity is NEITHER necessary nor sufficient for fullness; the correct invariant is connectedness of the monoidal unit. Verified computationally.

Sec 3: two distinct theorems conflated -- (a) full-faithfulness of the FIXED extension <<->> (governed by unit-connectedness of the enrichment base) and (b) Diers reconstruction S=pi_0(el F) from an abstract familially-representable functor (governed by extensivity of the CODOMAIN Set). At C=Set base=codomain=Set so (a),(b) fuse and 'extensivity' reads off both; off Set they separate. Diers/AAG cited, not reproved.

Cor 4.1 (T3): a lax monoidal F:Set->C sends Set-containers to Fam(C^op) with extension in C-enriched [C,C]; change of base induces change of enrichment. Full-faithful iff target unit connected; free-vector-space F1=k not connected => linearizing strictly loses naturality = ∐⊊⊕. Confirms Vec-enrichment as the invariant view. Eilenberg-Kelly/Cruttwell base-change is the generic mechanism; container instantiation is the delta.

Prop 4.2 (T2a): Dirichlet/Day tensor (SxT,(P_s(x)Q_t)) closed via pointwise Day right adjoint when C complete+monoidal-closed. Adjunction SHAPE identified; coproduct-completion bookkeeping NOT verified in general.
